notes: PERFORMANCE MODE: one switch for slow computers (base MacBooks, laptops with built-in graphics) - lower resolution, no shadows or grass, fewer effects, no ragdolls and fewer lamps in zombies. It's in Settings > VIDEO and one tap away in the pause menu; turning it off puts your settings back. If a match runs under 35 FPS for 20 seconds, the game suggests it.
FRAME GRAPH (Settings > VIDEO): your frame times, FPS, the slowest 1% of frames and the draw calls in the corner, to show where the game slows down.
MAP VOTING: between online rounds, vote for the next map from three on the results screen. The most votes win (private matches with a fixed map skip it).

NEW GRENADES (pick them in your class): the HOTBOX GRENADE throws a thick smoke cloud for 14 s that nobody can see through, bots included; the SKUNK BOMB blinds anyone looking at it with a green flash, then leaves a stink cloud where enemies can't aim. Everyone online sees the clouds.
